integrity: The covariance is reconstructed directly from independence of the post-return future and the centered second-moment identity. The simple-walk specialization is independently replayed by exhaustive path enumeration and exact central-binomial arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The local time counts exact returns to the origin and excludes time zero.
The all-increment theorem concerns terminal quadratic energy, not arbitrary endpoint functionals.
The explicit correlation formula is specialized to the one-dimensional simple symmetric random walk.
title: Return local time has an exact age-weighted covariance with terminal energy
